scoring_time.timestamp_definition: T0=leads.created_at; T1=first inquiries.inquiry_at; T2=second and later inquiries.inquiry_at while no scheduled_visit has already occurred

population.eligibility: Scoring snapshots with a complete 30-day future observation window; T1/T2 are generated only before a known scheduled visit has occurred.
exclusions: Dynamic snapshots after an already observed scheduled visit.
Current/future broker-response information from model inputs.

spec.question: How much of the frozen RF specialist's held-out performance depends on calendar and funnel-progress clocks that may capture temporal drift?
spec.hypothesis: If drift-sensitive timing/progress variables materially drive the model, removing them will reduce held-out AP/AUC and a time-proxy-only diagnostic will retain non-trivial discrimination.
spec.primary_change: remove calendar and funnel-progress timing features while holding model, target, population and frozen temporal split fixed
secondary_changes: fit a diagnostic time-proxy-only model using safe cohort/time indices; it is not a production candidate

validation.split_description: Chronological 70/15/15 split by lead creation; every T0/T1/T2 snapshot for a lead is assigned to the same partition. Validation controls early stopping and calibration; test is untouched until final evaluation.
